summary_1line: After slaying Lavana, Shatrughna visits Valmiki’s hermitage, receives praise and hospitality, and listens to songs recounting Rama’s story.

image_candidates.scene_text: At Valmiki’s forest hermitage, the sage affectionately smells the crown of Shatrughna’s head after praising his victory over Lavana.
Shatrughna sits with his retinue in the hermitage while bards sing Rama’s history to the accompaniment of stringed instruments.
